effect.eternal_starlight.crystal_infecti: Inflige dano letal ao longo do tempo e diminui a armadura; níveis mais altos causam mais dano e diminuem mais armadura.
effect.eternal_starlight.dream_catcher.d: Aumenta a armadura; níveis mais altos aumentam mais armadura.
effect.eternal_starlight.sticky.descript: Diminui levemente a velocidade e permite que o jogador escale qualquer bloco; níveis mais altos diminuem mais a velocidade.
effect.eternal_starlight.flammable.descr: Aumenta o dano de fogo causado à vítima; níveis mais altos aumentam mais o dano de fogo.
effect.eternal_starlight.brittle.descrip: Aumenta o dano de congelamento causado à vítima; níveis mais altos aumentam ainda mais o dano de congelamento.
effect.eternal_starlight.numbness.descri: Absorve três quartos do dano recebido pelo jogador e reaplica o dano absorvido ao jogador no final do efeito.
effect.eternal_starlight.teary.descripti: Embaça a visão do jogador e cancela o alvo de ataque dos monstros; O monstro afetado desenvolverá imunidade a isso após um certo período de tempo.
effect.eternal_starlight.starfire.descri: Quando o portador do efeito é danificado, os monstros ao seu redor também recebem dano; Quando o portador do efeito morre, o efeito se espalha para os monstros ao redor.
effect.eternal_starlight.oblivion.descri: Permite ao jogador atravessar paredes enquanto o bloco abaixo continua fornecendo suporte. Agachar permite descer através de blocos. Também aumenta a velocidade de movimento, reduz a gravidade e encurta a distância que inimigos seguem.
attribute.name.eternal_starlight.generic: Multiplicador de Alcance de Perseguição de Inimigos
Envenena os atacantes quando você recebe dano
enchantment.eternal_starlight.fearless.d: Aumenta a repulsão e avança em direção aos inimigos ao atacar

enchantment.eternal_starlight.tracing.de: Aplica Brilho aos alvos atingidos pela Corrente das Almas
enchantment.eternal_starlight.tearing.de: Inflige o efeito Lacrimejante em acertos com a lança
enchantment.eternal_starlight.glacial_so: Congela os alvos atingidos por sementes
enchantment.eternal_starlight.fertile.de: Aumenta o número de sementes lançadas

enchantment.eternal_starlight.swift_lash: Aumenta a velocidade de ataque do chicote
enchantment.eternal_starlight.abyssal_to: Incendeia os alvos com fogo abissal ao atingir

tooltip.eternal_starlight.warhammer_pend: Aumenta dano com velocidade de movimento

tooltip.eternal_starlight.pearl_necklace: Reabastece instantaneamente o oxigênio quando o usuário sai da água

book.eternal_starlight.seeking_eye: Um olho mágico que pode ser usado para localizar as ruínas onde vivem as criaturas poderosas. Você também precisa segurar um item localizador se desejar encontrar uma estrutura específica.

It can be used on the portal frame to open the portal to the Starlight Dimension.
book.eternal_starlight.accessories.title: Acessórios
book.eternal_starlight.accessories:
Os acessórios são itens que podem ser combinados com equipamentos para conceder propriedades únicas. Cada acessório só pode ser combinado com um tipo específico de equipamento.
O número de acessórios que um equipamento pode carregar depende da quantidade de slots de acessórios que ele possui. Você pode combinar ou separar acessórios do equipamento da mesma forma que colocaria ou removeria itens de um pacote. Além disso, a combinação pode ser feita diretamente através da criação. Quando a durabilidade de um item é esgotada, todos os acessórios combinados serão perdidos.
Os acessórios podem ser obtidos de mobs ou baús. Além disso, alguns acessórios possuem métodos de aquisição exclusivos.
book.eternal_starlight.nocturnal_millet:
Nocturnal Millet is a crop native to the Starlight Dimension, whose seeds are hidden within Thioquartz at the banks of the Ether River.
Nocturnal Millet seeds can be sown on dirt, farmland, or Dusted Gravel. Once the stalks have grown, the tops will naturally produce panicles.
When the panicles are plump and ripe, interacting with or destroying them will grant Nocturnal Millet. The stalks will remain after harvesting, but there is also a small probability that they will wither. Withered Nocturnal Millet will continuously destroy other types of crops nearby. If a stalk loses its vitality, applying bone meal can revive it.
If Nocturnal Millet is planted on Dusted Gravel and bone meal is applied to the stalk, the entire plant will enter a state of forgotten. Panicles in this state no longer produce ordinary Nocturnal Millet, but instead condense into Forgotten Nocturnal Millet. Plants in the forgotten state will seize the life force of other types of crops nearby to accelerate their own maturation.
book.eternal_starlight.amaramber.title: Amaramber
book.eternal_starlight.amaramber:
Amaramber is a resin that seeps from the bark of Torreya trees, which grow in the Torreya Forest. When the bark of a Torreya Log is stripped with an axe, there is a chance that a lump of raw Amaramber will come away with it. Breaking a Torreya Campfire can also yield the resin, for the burning fire draws it out from deep within the wood.
In a crafting table, raw Amaramber can be combined with Deepslate to forge two Amaramber Ingots. The resin burns long and steadily, which also makes it an excellent fuel.
The light of burning Amaramber carries an invisible virtue. In the Starlight dimension, an Amaramber Lantern, a lit Amaramber Candle, a burning Torreya Campfire, or a blaze of Amaramber Fire will keep hostile monsters from appearing nearby. Such a fire can be kindled by lighting a Block of Raw Amaramber with flint and steel, for the flame that rises from it is an Amaramber Fire.
book.eternal_starlight.gleech: Vampires of the Crystallized Desert, tiny in size but with enormous appetites. Adult Gleeches often carry dormant eggs inside their bodies, and if they never find enough nourishment to feed their young, they end up becoming the first meal of their own offspring. Thanks to their long shelf life, Gleech Eggs can be used as powerful thrown weapons. Upon hitting an enemy, an egg instantly releases a hungry young Gleech to bite it. Note that these ravenous larvae will not spare you simply because you released them, so keep your distance when using this weapon.
book.eternal_starlight.lonestar_skeleton:
Skeletons controlled by an ancient power from the stars, and extremely dangerous enemies for explorers. They attack by hurling the blades of the Shattered Swords they carry, dealing considerable damage, and sometimes team up with Nightfall Spiders to form an even more dangerous combination.
The Shattered Sword in their hands is a powerful weapon, and perhaps you could seize one from them.
book.eternal_starlight.nightfall_spider:
Creatures found almost everywhere across the Starlight dimension. Armed with venomous fangs that make their prey glow and the ability to climb walls, they actively hunt adventurers lurking in dim places under the eternal twilight. While Nightfall Spiders are unremarkable in strength and speed, their wide distribution and sheer numbers make them troublesome foes.
Sometimes they join forces with Lonestar Skeletons to form an even more dangerous combination.
book.eternal_starlight.seeker:
These floating mollusks move through the air by jet propulsion, ever ready to scrape a chunk of flesh from any prey that wanders into their sight with their long, thorny tongues.
Seekers stay afloat on gas held within their bodies, which prevents them from moving about in the strong winds of the high skies. Thus, despite their ability to fly, they seldom stray far above the ground.
book.eternal_starlight.thirst_walker: A strange humanoid that roams the Crystallized Desert. Some say they are ancient mummies reanimated by an undead curse; others claim they are some kind of Enderman living in symbiosis with crystals. But whatever they once were, they are now nothing more than monsters wandering in endless hunger. These creatures like to stalk adventurers and, catching them off guard, bite a chunk of flesh off their bodies before fleeing immediately. Their teeth possess a peculiar property: even after falling out, they remain somehow active, and can be used to craft mining machines and all kinds of weapons. If you block their bites with a shield, you can knock their teeth loose. For adventurers of some skill, however, simply hunting them down may be a far more efficient way to gather teeth.
book.eternal_starlight.dagger_of_hunger:
Uma arma criada usando os dentes dos Andarilhos Sedentos, os materiais usados para fazê-la permitem que ela absorva nutrientes para aumentar sua afiação.
Parece reter atividade e uma necessidade primal por comida, tanto que pode agir e trair seu mestre em casos de fome extrema.
book.eternal_starlight.crystalborn_catal:
Uma máquina que usa os dentes dos Andarilhos Sedentos como seu material principal, herdando a ganância do Andarilho Sedento.
Ao receber um sinal de redstone, ela pode usar os cristais nela para infestar ambientes próximos e coletar os recursos contidos neles.
book.eternal_starlight.creteor:
Scholars of the many ancient Starlight civilizations agree that Creepers are connected to the stars above, and in these theories the Creteor often serves as the key piece of evidence. These strange five-pointed star-shaped creatures descend from the sky alongside meteor showers, and no one can say where they truly come from. Compared with ordinary Creepers, they are gentler and will not chase adventurers on their own, but that does not mean hunting them is any easier than hunting an ordinary Creeper. They can crush adventurers by rolling over them, and after exploding they leave behind several Tiny Creteors.
The hide of a Creteor can be used to craft all kinds of equipment, making it an especially valuable resource for novice adventurers.
book.eternal_starlight.tiny_creteor:
Ill-tempered creatures that rain down during meteor showers, or are born from the explosions of Creteors. Like most Creepers, they detonate once they get close to an adventurer.
Apart from their hide, we know almost nothing about these visitors from beyond the stars. The scholars who studied them went extinct before they could truly understand them.
book.eternal_starlight.stranghoul:
These bizarre humanoid creatures seem to have started appearing only after that disaster, and no one knows where they came from. For some reason, they are especially afraid of silver weapons.
Though their habits are quite feral, they still possess a considerable degree of intelligence and a primitive civilization. As such, rather than making enemies of them, bartering with them using Malarite or hiring them to fight for you with bowls of Pungency Stew is clearly the wiser choice.
Their frail bodies make them inclined toward scavenging, and healthy adventurers hold little interest for them, yet when choosing food they will not refuse the dying. Loitering near a Stranghoul while in poor health is an especially dangerous idea, as they may fail to suppress their savage impulses and tear you apart.
book.eternal_starlight.pungency_fruit:
Uma fruta encontrada em todo o Pântano Sombrio que tem um gosto parecido com alho, ela exala um odor que faz as pessoas chorarem, o que permite que seja feita como arma também.
Um ensopado feito dela e carne podre pode livrá-lo do efeito de fome, mas essa comida não parece ser muito saborosa.
book.eternal_starlight.silver_pungency_f: Um alimento precioso feito de Frutas Pungentes e Barras de Prata Abissal que ainda retém o sabor das Frutas Pungentes. Ele paralisia seus nervos, fazendo com que seu corpo ignore temporariamente a maior parte do dano, mas todo o dano ainda é devolvido após um período de tempo.
book.eternal_starlight.seeds_launcher:
Esta arma única pode atirar sementes de qualquer tipo em alta velocidade, é feita principalmente de Frutas Pungentes, mas o método exato de produção é desconhecido, então a única maneira de obtê-la é trocando com seus fabricantes.
A arma pode ser encantada, e quando encantada pode atirar sementes com propriedades únicas.
book.eternal_starlight.drying_rack:
Carniçais Estranhos usam isso para secar carne podre e transformá-la em couro para suas armaduras.
Pode ser colocado sobre uma fogueira, momento em que a carne podre pode ser colocada para obter Charque de Carne Podre, que é mais saboroso, mas mais difícil de mastigar do que a carne podre.
book.eternal_starlight.ent:
Harmless plant spirits made of plant matter and the souls bound within it, whose canopy color often matches the land where they grow. They can be bred with Abyssal Fruit and Lunar Berries.
It is said that the Ent and the souls trapped within them provided the inspiration for the creation of the Lunar Monstrosity.
book.eternal_starlight.ratlin: Ratlin can be found on the surface of almost every land biome. Common omnivores, they can be bred with Cave Moss, glowing lichen, and all kinds of meat, making them a reliable source of food and leather. Many civilizations across the Starlight dimension have raised these creatures on a grand scale.
book.eternal_starlight.zombified_ratlin:
Even after the undead curse of the Dark Swamp turned them into zombies, they have kept their timid nature and will not attack adventurers on their own. However, once a single one is provoked into aggression, every Zombified Ratlin nearby will follow it into the fray.
The Stranghoul that haunt the same Dark Swamp often prey upon them.
book.eternal_starlight.shadow_snail: A slow but tenacious mollusk that relies on its sturdy shell to fend off predators, able to survive in most biomes except the Crystallized Desert. When the Starlight civilization still flourished, they were raised in large numbers for their meat. Their flesh is nutritious food, and their crushed shells serve as fertilizer, as well as an important source of black dye. Shadow Snails are not picky eaters, and with nothing more than leaves, moss, or berries you can easily breed them.
book.eternal_starlight.yeti: A fairly common creature of the Starlight Permafrost Forest, covered in thick, springy white fur that can be harvested with shears and used to craft carpets and beds. They love Lunar Berries and Cave Moss, and feeding them these foods encourages breeding. When attacked, they tumble away to escape.
book.eternal_starlight.aurora_deer:
Herbivores that live in the Starlight Permafrost Forest, famed for their beautiful blue-green antlers. When attacked, Aurora Deer fight back with those antlers. If you can guide them into crashing against hard stone, the antlers will fall off. Hard and sharp, they can be used as weapons directly.
Aurora Deer adore all kinds of berries; whether Lunar Berries or Abyssal Fruit, either can lure them in or help breed them.
book.eternal_starlight.crystallized_moth:
Hunters that roam beneath the Crystallized Desert, skilled at hunting bats with powerful sonar blasts. These seemingly fragile insects should not be underestimated: not only do they dodge attacks with their flight, they can also unleash sonar that cannot be blocked by shields. Moreover, they cooperate with one another in battle. They will not attack adventurers unprovoked, and once fed enough meat, they will fight for you as loyal guards.
A tamed Crystallized Moth can turn Lunaris Cactus Gel into Shivering Gel. This dense gel is an important crafting material used to make Sonar Bombs and the Crystal Greatsword.
book.eternal_starlight.shimmer_lacewing: An insect fluttering near the Shimmer River, the Dark Swamp, and the Solaris Isles, with four pairs of glowing blue, purple, or orange wings. Their presence is neither a threat nor a boon to anything else. Back when the Starlight civilization still stood, these were little creatures beloved by children.
book.eternal_starlight.starfire_bird:
These little birds of the Starlight Forest have red or blue feathers and can produce a unique substance known as Starfire. Starfire can be thrown as a weapon, used to enhance Thermal Springstone gear and Torreya campfires, and can also melt Twilight Sand into Flowglaze.
Winning the favor of these adorable birds is essential to obtain this special material. To do so, find their nests in the canopies of Lunar Trees and place seeds inside as a gift, and the Starfire Birds will reward you with various precious items, Starfire included.
If climbing the towering Lunar Trees seems too dangerous, you can build Starfire Bird Aviaries of your own, or take a Silk Touch axe and remove the nest, birds and all, from the treetop.
Breeding Starfire Birds is not complicated. Feed seeds to two of them and they will lay an egg in their nest. While the egg is incubating, do not break the nest unless you carry a Silk Touch axe, or the egg will be destroyed along with it.
book.eternal_starlight.grimstone_golem: The most basic golem, summoned by placing a Carved Lunaris Cactus Fruit on top of Grimstone Bricks. They are commonly used as item display stands.
book.eternal_starlight.aethersent_golem: A golem invented by the ancient Starlighters to protect against meteor showers, summoned by placing a Carved Lunaris Cactus Fruit on a Block of Aethersent. Its powerful cannon can deliver precise, devastating strikes against any aerial enemy that approaches. It can even shatter falling meteors before they destroy the buildings below. However, it is completely incapable of attacking targets on the ground.
book.eternal_starlight.rookfish: A common aquatic creature that spits ink to blind its enemies when hurt. They are remarkably useful creatures: not only can they be carried in buckets for long-distance transport, but they can also be turned into all sorts of delicacies. Their air sacs are likewise a valuable resource, used to craft Air Sac gear for working underwater and Air Sac Arrows.
book.eternal_starlight.luminofish: Small fish that swim in schools through the Abyss. When attacked, they puff up their bodies to release poison. Despite being poisonous, their toxin is easily broken down by stomach acid, so they can still be eaten as food.
book.eternal_starlight.luminaris:
One of the common aquatic creatures of the Abyss. Though capable of fighting, they will not attack divers on their own, only striking back when hurt.
The Luminaris has a glowing horn on its head that lures small creatures nearby for it to feed on. Besides that, they are renowned for their schooling behavior, swimming in groups, hunting in groups, and defending in groups. If you provoke one, the whole school will come to its aid. Though a single Luminaris has limited strength, their cooperative strategy is enough to make any enemy think twice before attacking.
book.eternal_starlight.twilight_gaze: Twilight Gaze are famed for their glowing purple eyes. In the Abyss, where they originate, these eyes let them see clearly in total darkness. They love the environment of the Abyss and will try to return to it if they stray too far away. This fish will not attack on its own, but harm one, and the Twilight Gaze will not hesitate to swarm you as one.
book.eternal_starlight.the_gatekeeper: The Gatekeepers guard the gates of the Starlight dimension. As members of this ancient and mysterious order, we come from all walks of life, yet we all share one age-old and sacred duty: to guard the gates of the Starlight dimension and ensure that only the brave and the strong may enter.
book.eternal_starlight.starlight_golem:
Mechanical creations built by the Starlighters to fend off the doom foretold by the prophets, they once boasted heavy armor and unrivaled strength. When the calamity finally came, however, the golems fell into madness, and the Starlighters realized in horror that they had built the very beast that prophecy said would destroy everything.
To this day, the army of golems that once wrought destruction has faded into the dust of history, and only in the golem forges that once built these giants do a few unfinished creations remain.
book.eternal_starlight.starlight_golem.d: The Starlight Golem's shield is unbreakable, yet these machines are far from invincible. When they overheat and must pause to recharge, simply deactivating the nearby energy blocks will cause the shield to fail.
book.eternal_starlight.starlight_golem.s: Como um ser imperfeito, ele não se move, o que reduz significativamente a dificuldade de combatê-lo.
book.eternal_starlight.freeze: Elemental beings mechanically modified by the Starlight civilization. The Frozen Tubes that form their bodies hold compressed reservoirs of ice elemental energy, and merely approaching them is enough to suffer frostbite, while their attacks can turn wide swathes of magma into obsidian. They were mass-produced in the golem forges to serve as guards and cooling units.
book.eternal_starlight.freeze.attack: Você pode se defender contra os ataques intensivos deles usando armadura à prova de frio.
book.eternal_starlight.permafrost:
After the Starlighters successfully converted Freezes into cooling units, they soon realized that the magical energy dwelling within these beings far exceeded their expectations. By fusing and augmenting multiple Freezes, they created the Permafrost, the ultimate cooling unit.
As the perfect upgrade of the Freeze, the Permafrost inherits its instincts while wielding far greater command over frost: it can spew icy saliva cold enough to freeze the ground, and hurl countless Frozen Tubes in every direction.
Even long after the civilization has turned to dust, it still mechanically carries out its final directive among the ruins: to chill everything to absolute zero.
book.eternal_starlight.energy_transmitte:
O Transmissor de Energia é um dispositivo de redstone capaz de transmitir sinal de redstone por longas distâncias.
Para usá-lo, primeiro interaja com a extremidade emissora e, em seguida, com a extremidade receptora para estabelecer uma conexão entre as duas. Uma vez vinculado, o Transmissor de Energia emitirá um feixe de luz entre o emissor e o receptor enquanto estiver ativo.
O emissor coleta o sinal de redstone do bloco ao qual está conectado e o transmite sem fio, enquanto o receptor passa o sinal recebido para o bloco ao qual está conectado.
book.eternal_starlight.accumulator:
O Acumulador é um dispositivo de redstone que pode receber sinal de redstone de uma direção e emiti-lo em todas as outras direções.
Entre suas seis faces, aquela marcada com um ponto vermelho é a face de entrada, enquanto todas as outras faces são faces de saída. À medida que o sinal de entrada se fortalece, a cor do Acumulador muda gradualmente de cinza para azul.
book.eternal_starlight.lunar_monstrosity:
A wicked creation forged by the Starlighters from the flowers of the Lunar Vine, it possesses the power to bind souls and an insatiable hunger. In the century that followed, the maze it inhabits became the execution ground where successive rulers dealt with criminals and political enemies. Countless prisoners were thrown into this cursed garden: their bodies became the monstrosity's nourishment, while their souls remained trapped within the maze, serving as the monstrosity's minions and the source of energy that drove the rulers' machines and fueled their magic.
No one, living or dead, has ever found a way out of this maze.
Unless you can put an end to it all.
The Lunar Monstrosity is covered in an extremely resilient epidermis; unless its shell is scorched with fire, most weapons can barely deal any damage to it.
Como uma planta, ela permanece imóvel na maior parte do tempo, mas ocasionalmente se enterra no solo para caçar sua presa.
book.eternal_starlight.tangled:
The souls of prisoners bound by the Lunar Vine within the Cursed Garden, assimilated into the vine's vast root network after death. To this day they still wander the maze in packs, dragging their new bodies grown from plant matter, ever ready to tear intruders apart with their venomous claws.
The Cursed Garden teems with Tangled. Bringing weapons that can strike a wide area beforehand is essential for exploring the maze.
book.eternal_starlight.tangled_skull:
The soul form that appears when a Tangled's plant shell is shattered. Still bound by the power of the Lunar Vine, they attack adventurers with boundless fury and resentment. Though their half-material bodies are extremely fragile, their light and nimble movement, along with the ability to pass through walls, makes them hard to hit with ordinary weapons. Wide-reaching weapons such as whips and Sonar Bombs may be your best bet against them.
Upon death, the instability of their forms causes them to explode in a small blast.
book.eternal_starlight.meteor_shower: Chuvas de meteoros às vezes ocorrem aqui. Durante a chuva de meteoros, inúmeros meteoros riscam o céu noturno, criando uma visão bela. Mas também há perigo na beleza, tenha cuidado para não ser atingido pelos grandes meteoritos. Depois de desviá-los, você pode encontrar alguns minérios no local de pouso. Creteors podem surgir após a aterrissagem dos grandes meteoritos, você pode matá-los para obter seu couro. Você também pode construir um Golem Aethersent para evitar que meteoros destruam sua casa, ou usar Foguetes de Golpe Etéreo para causar chuvas de meteoros manualmente.
